## Read and wrangle data

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(slider)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(icesdata)
library(FLCore)
library(rfishbase)
library(ggsidekick)
library(egg)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggeffects)

theme_set(theme_sleek())

home <- here::here()

source(paste0(home, "/R/functions/ggdharma.R"))

dat <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/dat.csv"))

mid_year <- round(median(1959:2022))

d <- dat |>
  mutate(
    species_f = as.factor(Species),
    stock_f = as.factor(stock),
    year_ct = year - mid_year
  ) |>
  group_by(stock_f, species_f) |>
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(sst_lag1      = lag(sst, 1)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(year >= 1959) |>
  mutate(
    sst_sc_lag1 = (sst_lag1 - mean(sst_lag1, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(sst_lag1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = stock_f
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Store the per-stock mean/sd used to build b0_sc so the back-transform (b0_stats, below)
    # always inverts b0_sc with the exact same constants, even though drop_na() afterwards
    # removes rows (e.g. the first year of each stock, lacking sst_lag1) from the fitting data.
    b0_mean_stock = mean(b0, na.rm = TRUE),
    b0_sd_stock = sd(b0, na.rm = TRUE),
    b0_sc = (b0 - b0_mean_stock) / b0_sd_stock,
    .by = stock_f
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(b0_sc, sst_sc_lag1) |>
  droplevels()
```

## Fit hierarchical GAM

```{r}
m_hgam <- mgcv::gam(
  b0_sc ~ s(year_ct, k = 12, m = 2) +
    s(year_ct, stock_f, bs = "fs", k = 4, m = 1),
  data = d,
  family = scat(),
  method = "REML"
)

saveRDS(m_hgam, paste0(home, "/output/m_hgam.rds"))

summary(m_hgam)
```

## QQ

```{r}
gam.check(m_hgam)

gg_dharma(simulateResiduals(m_hgam, plot = FALSE))

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/hgam_dharma_qq.pdf"), width = 19, height = 10, units = "cm")
```

## Predict

```{r}
stock_year_range <- d |> summarise(min_year_ct = min(year_ct), max_year_ct = max(year_ct), .by = stock_f)

nd <- stock_year_range |>
  rowwise() |>
  reframe(stock_f = stock_f, year_ct = seq(min_year_ct, max_year_ct)) |>
  left_join(distinct(d, stock_f, species_f), by = "stock_f") |>
  mutate(year = year_ct + mid_year)

pr <- predict(m_hgam, newdata = nd, se.fit = TRUE)
nd$pred <- pr$fit
nd$pred_se <- pr$se.fit

gl <- predict(m_hgam, newdata = nd, exclude = "s(year_ct,stock_f)", se.fit = TRUE)
nd$global <- gl$fit
nd$global_se <- gl$se.fit
nd$global_lwr <- nd$global - 1.96 * nd$global_se
nd$global_upr <- nd$global + 1.96 * nd$global_se
```

## Model fit against raw data

```{r}
b0_stats <- d |> distinct(stock_f, b0_mean = b0_mean_stock, b0_sd = b0_sd_stock)

# b0 = B0(t) / virgin biomass (see 02-b0.R), not B0(t)/mean(B0(t)), so b0_mean is a per-stock
# average depletion level and is not expected to equal 1. What must hold is that b0_stats uses
# the exact same mean/sd that built b0_sc, which is now guaranteed by construction above.
stopifnot(all(b0_stats$b0_sd > 0))

fit_raw <- nd |>
  left_join(b0_stats, by = "stock_f") |>
  mutate(
    pred_raw = pred * b0_sd + b0_mean,
    lwr_raw  = (pred - 1.96 * pred_se) * b0_sd + b0_mean,
    upr_raw  = (pred + 1.96 * pred_se) * b0_sd + b0_mean
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = d, aes(year, b0), color = "grey30", size = 0.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = fit_raw, aes(year, ymin = lwr_raw, ymax = upr_raw), fill = "tomato3", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = fit_raw, aes(year, pred_raw), color = "tomato3", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~stock_f, scales = "free_y", ncol = 6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "grey10", alpha = 0.4, lty = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1980, 2020)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(paste("Relative ", B[0]))) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x.top = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/hgam_fit_vs_raw_b0.pdf"), width = 21, height = 30, units = "cm")
```

## Global (shared) smooth

```{r}
global_dat <- nd |> distinct(year, global, global_lwr, global_upr)

# Simulate coefficient vectors from (coef(m_hgam), vcov(m_hgam)) (the standard Bayesian interpretation of a penalized GAM fit, Wood 2017), multiply each draw through the lpmatrix for the global-only prediction (group term zeroed via `exclude`, same as the point prediction above), one line per draw.

n_draws <- 30

nd_global <- distinct(nd, year, year_ct) |> mutate(stock_f = levels(d$stock_f)[1])

Xp_global <- predict(m_hgam, newdata = nd_global, type = "lpmatrix", exclude = "s(year_ct,stock_f)")
beta_draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_draws, coef(m_hgam), vcov(m_hgam))
draw_mat <- Xp_global %*% t(beta_draws)
colnames(draw_mat) <- paste0("draw_", seq_len(n_draws))

draws_dat <- as_tibble(draw_mat) |>
  mutate(year = nd_global$year) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("draw_"), names_to = "draw", values_to = "global")

pal <- brewer.pal(n = 3, "Dark2")[1]

ggplot(global_dat, aes(year, global)) +
  geom_line(data = draws_dat, aes(group = draw), color = pal, alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = global_lwr, ymax = global_upr), alpha = 0.25, fill = pal) +
  geom_line(color = pal, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    data = d |> summarise(mean = mean(b0_sc), n_stocks = n_distinct(stock_f), .by = year),
    aes(year, mean, size = n_stocks),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = 0) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.9, 5)) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(position = "inside")) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(paste("Global smooth of ", B[0]^{
      sc
    })),
    size = "N stocks"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position.inside = c(0.95, 0.95), legend.justification = c(1, 1))

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/hgam_year_global.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9, units = "cm")
```

## Stock trajectories (delta)

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Trajectory shape per stock, from the fitted curve itself (nd$pred), restricted to 1995-2019 when stock coverage is more balanced (10 stocks in 1959, 74 by 1995, then a stable ~79 through 2019).

traj_summary <- nd |>
  filter(year >= 1995, year <= 2019) |>
  group_by(stock_f) |>
  summarise(
    first_pred = pred[which.min(year)],
    last_pred = pred[which.max(year)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Approach below based on Wood 2017; 4.8.4 Bayesian confidence intervals for non-linear functions of parameters
# Loop through each stock and take the prediction for 2019 and 1995. 
# Get the uncertainty on the delta of those predictions by simulating 2000 draws of the model's coefficients from their approximate sampling distribution (Wood, 2017). 
# Each draw givs a realisation of a simulated b0_sc at 1995 and 2019, which is then back-transformed to raw B0 using the stock's own mean and SD and converted to a percent change.
# We take the median, SD and quantiles of the distribution of percentages
# Draws where the simulated raw B0 falls at or below zero (biologically impossible but can happen here since the model's response variable is a z-scored variable) are also tracked. 
# Stocks lacking either boundary year are dropped below (n=1).

nsim <- 2000 # posterior draws per stock
b <- coef(m_hgam) # fitted coefficients (same for every stock)
V <- vcov(m_hgam, unconditional = TRUE) # coefficient covariance (includes smoothing-parameter uncertainty)

trend_list <- vector("list", nrow(traj_summary)) # one slot per stock, filled in the loop below

set.seed(42) # fix the RNG so pct_change_total/pct_sd/pct_lwr/pct_upr are reproducible across re-knits

for (i in seq_len(nrow(traj_summary))) { # one iteration per stock in traj_summary
  stock_id <- traj_summary$stock_f[i] # the stock this iteration is computing

  sub <- nd |> filter(stock_f == stock_id, year %in% c(1995, 2019)) # this stock's 1995 and 2019 rows only

  if (!all(c(1995, 2019) %in% sub$year)) { # stock doesn't bracket 1995-2019 -> store an NA row and move on
    trend_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      stock_f = stock_id,
      pct_change_total = NA_real_, pct_sd = NA_real_, pct_lwr = NA_real_, pct_upr = NA_real_,
      prop_early_nonpos = NA_real_, prop_late_nonpos = NA_real_
    )
    next
  }
  
  # Ith stock's b0_mean/b0_sd, to back-transform b0_sc to raw b0
  st <- b0_stats |> filter(stock_f == stock_id) 

  # Grab the design matrix for each year in nd pred
  Xp <- predict(m_hgam, newdata = sub, type = "lpmatrix")
  ce <- Xp[sub$year == 1995, ]
  cl <- Xp[sub$year == 2019, ]

  # Draw nsim (rows) random coefficient vectors from a MVN with covariance V
  B <- mgcv::rmvn(nsim, b, V)
  # Multiply realized simulated coefficient with the design matrix row and rescale back to b0!
  early <- as.numeric(B %*% ce) * st$b0_sd + st$b0_mean 
  late  <- as.numeric(B %*% cl) * st$b0_sd + st$b0_mean 
  # Percent change
  pct <- (late / early - 1) * 100

  trend_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    stock_f = stock_id, 
    pct_change_total = median(pct), # median change in percent across stocks
    pct_sd = sd(pct), # empirical SD of the simulated % change (used as a precision weight downstream)
    pct_lwr = unname(quantile(pct, 0.025)), # 2.5th percentile of simulated % change
    pct_upr = unname(quantile(pct, 0.975)), # 97.5th percentile of simulated % change
    prop_early_nonpos = mean(early <= 0), # share of draws where simulated 1995 b0 was <= 0
    prop_late_nonpos = mean(late <= 0) # share of draws where simulated 2019 b0 was <= 0
  )
}

trend_dat <- bind_rows(trend_list)

traj_summary <- traj_summary |>
  left_join(trend_dat, by = "stock_f") |>
  filter(!is.na(pct_change_total)) # drop stocks missing 1995 or 2019

# Sanity checks before reporting
cat("min(pred_raw) across all stocks/years:", min(fit_raw$pred_raw), "\n")
flagged <- traj_summary |> filter(prop_early_nonpos > 0)
if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
  cat(nrow(flagged), "stock(s) dropped: posterior draws with 1995 B0 <= 0:\n")
  print(flagged |> select(stock_f, pct_change_total, prop_early_nonpos, prop_late_nonpos))
} else {
  cat("No stocks have posterior draws with 1995 B0 <= 0.\n")
}

traj_summary <- traj_summary |> filter(prop_early_nonpos == 0)

pct_change <- traj_summary |> select(stock_f, pct_change_total)

# Significance: CI (from the same simulation as pct_change_total, so consistent with it) excludes 0.
traj_summary <- traj_summary |>
  mutate(pct_sig = pct_lwr > 0 | pct_upr < 0)

tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Median cumulative % change (1995 to 2019)",
    "Stocks declining (point estimate)",
    "Stocks increasing (point estimate)",
    "Stocks declining (95% CI excludes 0)",
    "Stocks increasing (95% CI excludes 0)"
  ),
  value = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", median(pct_change$pct_change_total)),
    sprintf("%d of %d", sum(pct_change$pct_change_total < 0), nrow(pct_change)),
    sprintf("%d of %d", sum(pct_change$pct_change_total > 0), nrow(pct_change)),
    sprintf("%d of %d", sum(traj_summary$pct_sig & traj_summary$pct_change_total < 0), nrow(traj_summary)),
    sprintf("%d of %d", sum(traj_summary$pct_sig & traj_summary$pct_change_total > 0), nrow(traj_summary))
  )
)
```

### Plot delta prediction (2019 vs 1995)

```{r}
stock_order <- traj_summary |>
  arrange(desc(pct_change_total)) |>
  pull(stock_f)

# pct_lwr/pct_upr come directly from the coefficient-posterior simulation above,
# so this CI already accounts for the ratio's skew.
cater_dat <- traj_summary |>
  transmute(
    stock_f,
    estimate = pct_change_total,
    conf.low = pct_lwr,
    conf.high = pct_upr
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      conf.low > 0 ~ "Positive sig.",
      conf.high < 0 ~ "Negative sig.",
      TRUE ~ "No effect"
    ),
    stock_f = factor(stock_f, levels = stock_order)
  )

n_stocks <- n_distinct(cater_dat$stock_f)
median_pct <- median(cater_dat$estimate)

pct_dat <- cater_dat |>
  count(sig) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n))) |>
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      sig == "Positive sig." ~ sprintf("Increasing: %d%%", pct),
      sig == "Negative sig." ~ sprintf("Decreasing: %d%%", pct),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("No change: %d%%", pct)
    ),
    y_pos = case_when(
      sig == "Negative sig." ~ 3,
      sig == "No effect" ~ 4.5,
      sig == "Positive sig." ~ 6
    )
  )

ggplot(cater_dat, aes(y = stock_f, x = estimate, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_pct, color = "tomato", linetype = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = pct_dat, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, vjust = y_pos, label = label, color = sig),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, label = sprintf("Median change: %.0f%%", median_pct),
    hjust = 1.05, size = 3, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Positive sig." = "steelblue",
    "Negative sig." = "tomato",
    "No effect"     = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(x = expression(paste("Percent change in ", B[0])), y = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/hgam_trend_since_1995_caterpillar.pdf"), width = 14, height = 24, units = "cm")
```

## Life history and habitat variables affecting delta
### Add life history traits, taxonomy and habitat variables

```{r}
# Life-history traits + species, from icesdata's fishlife attribute
traits <- names(icesdata) |>
  map(function(stock_name) {
    stk <- icesdata[[stock_name]]
    fl <- attributes(stk)$fishlife
    if (is.null(fl)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    tibble(
      stock_f = stock_name, species = attributes(stk)$species,
      linf = unname(fl["linf"]), k = unname(fl["k"]),
      age_maturity = mean(as.numeric(mat50(stk)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

# WoRMS species-to-family lookup from the stomachr package, plus a manual patch for species missing from that lookup (data from stomachr package)
load("/Users/maxlindmark/Dropbox/max-work/R/stomachr/data/worms_lookup.rda")
fam_lookup <- worms_lookup |> distinct(scientific_name, family)
fam_manual <- tibble(
  scientific_name = c(
    "Lophius budegassa", "Dicentrarchus labrax", "Lepidorhombus boscii",
    "Sardina pilchardus", "Sebastes mentella", "Sebastes norvegicus", "Brosme brosme"
  ),
  family = c("Lophiidae", "Moronidae", "Scophthalmidae", "Clupeidae", "Sebastidae", "Sebastidae", "Lotidae")
)
fam_lookup <- bind_rows(fam_lookup, fam_manual)

# Demersal/pelagic/benthic habitat guild from FishBase
species_list <- unique(traits$species)
fb <- species(species_list) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(species = Species, DemersPelag)

# Mean F per stock, F-at-age averaged across ages each year, over each stock's full available history.

f_summary <- names(icesdata) |>
  map(function(id) {
    stk <- icesdata[[id]]
    f_by_year <- apply(harvest(stk)@.Data, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    tibble(stock_f = id, mean_F = mean(f_by_year, na.rm = TRUE), cumulative_F = sum(f_by_year, na.rm = TRUE))
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

n_years_tab <- names(icesdata) |>
  map(function(id) tibble(stock_f = id, n_years = dim(FLCore::harvest(icesdata[[id]]))[2])) |>
  list_rbind()

traj_traits <- traj_summary |>
  left_join(traits, by = "stock_f") |>
  left_join(fam_lookup, by = c("species" = "scientific_name")) |>
  left_join(fb, by = "species") |>
  left_join(f_summary, by = "stock_f") |>
  left_join(n_years_tab, by = "stock_f") |>
  mutate(
    # Collapse FishBase's ~6 DemersPelag categories to 3 for readability.
    # Pandalus borealis (pra.27.3a4a) isn't in FishBase, manually classified as benthopelagic (bottom-associated shrimp).
    habitat_guild3 = case_when(
      stock_f == "pra.27.3a4a" ~ "Benthopelagic",
      DemersPelag %in% c("demersal", "bathydemersal") ~ "Demersal",
      DemersPelag == "benthopelagic" ~ "Benthopelagic",
      DemersPelag %in% c("bathypelagic", "pelagic-neritic", "pelagic-oceanic") ~ "Pelagic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

saveRDS(traj_traits, paste0(home, "/output/traj_traits.rds"))
```

### Weighted multiple regression

```{r}
mean_F_ctr <- mean(traj_traits$mean_F)
mean_F_sd <- sd(traj_traits$mean_F)
linf_ctr <- mean(traj_traits$linf)
linf_sd <- sd(traj_traits$linf)
k_ctr <- mean(traj_traits$k)
k_sd <- sd(traj_traits$k)
age_ctr <- mean(traj_traits$age_maturity)
age_sd <- sd(traj_traits$age_maturity)

traj_traits <- traj_traits |>
  mutate(
    mean_F_z = (mean_F - mean_F_ctr) / mean_F_sd,
    linf_z = (linf - linf_ctr) / linf_sd,
    k_z = (k - k_ctr) / k_sd,
    age_maturity_z = (age_maturity - age_ctr) / age_sd
  )

fit <- lm(
  pct_change_total ~ mean_F_z + linf_z + k_z + age_maturity_z,
  data = traj_traits, weights = 1 / pct_sd^2
)

summary(fit)

car::vif(fit)

# Estimates
s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
ci <- confint(fit)

coef_dat <- tibble(
  term = rownames(s)[-1],
  estimate = s[-1, "Estimate"],
  conf.low = ci[-1, 1],
  conf.high = ci[-1, 2],
  p.value = s[-1, "Pr(>|t|)"]
) |>
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      "mean_F_z" = "Mean F", "linf_z" = "Linf",
      "k_z" = "von Bertalanffy k", "age_maturity_z" = "Age at maturity"
    ),
    sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig.", "No effect")
  )

ggplot(coef_dat, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate), xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sig." = "steelblue", "No effect" = "grey60")) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(x = "Estimate", y = NULL)

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/hgam_trait_cor_caterpillar.pdf"), width = 14, height = 8, units = "cm")

# Predictions
g <- ggeffect(fit, "mean_F_z")
s <- summary(fit)
eq_label <- sprintf("italic(R)^2 == %.2f * ',' ~ italic(p) == %.3f",
                    s$r.squared, coef(s)["mean_F_z", 4])

plot(g, show_residuals = TRUE)

p_meanF <- plot(g, show_data = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, show_title = FALSE)

# Each stock's own 95% CI on pct_change_total (from the simulation), drawn under the points/ribbon
# so the plot visually communicates the same per-stock precision the regression weights on
# (1 / pct_sd^2) -- wide segments are noisy, down-weighted stocks; short segments are precise ones.
seg_layer <- geom_segment(
  data = traj_traits,
  aes(x = mean_F_z, xend = mean_F_z, y = pct_lwr, yend = pct_upr),
  inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3
)
p_meanF$layers <- append(p_meanF$layers, list(seg_layer), after = 0)

p_meanF +
  theme_sleek() +
  labs(x = "Mean F (z-scored)",
       y = expression(paste("Percent change in ", B[0]))) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = eq_label, parse = TRUE,
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 3)

       width = 11, height = 11, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
mean(year_sst_cor$r)
median(year_sst_cor$r)
```

### SST alone explains little deviance

```{r}
# While many temperature effects come out as significant without year smooths, they dont explain much of variability (trends over time). Another argument for why we prefer year smooth over temperature.
m_sst_only <- gam(b0_sc ~ sst_sc_lag1, data = d, family = scat(), method = "REML")

summary(m_sst_only)$p.table

cat("SST-only deviance explained:", summary(m_sst_only)$dev.expl, "\n")
cat("Full trend model (m_hgam) deviance explained:", summary(m_hgam)$dev.expl, "\n")
```

### SST as an uncorrelated random slope with and without stock random year smooth

```{r}
# Testing if the per-stock year smooth competes with SST for shared signal. Removing it should let SST's random slope absorb more of that signal (wider spread, more significant stocks) than the version with the per-stock smooth still in the model.

m_hgam_sst <- mgcv::gam(
  b0_sc ~ s(year_ct, k = 12, m = 2) +
    s(year_ct, stock_f, bs = "fs", k = 4, m = 1) +
    sst_sc_lag1 +
    s(stock_f, sst_sc_lag1, bs = "re"),
  data = d,
  method = "REML"
)

m_hgam_sst_noyearslope <- mgcv::gam(
  b0_sc ~ s(year_ct, k = 12, m = 2) +
    sst_sc_lag1 +
    s(stock_f, sst_sc_lag1, bs = "re"),
  data = d,
  method = "REML"
)

# Here we use SST detrended within each stock (residuals of sst_sc_lag1 ~ year_ct) instead of raw (scaled) SST. If the many "significant" slopes in the no-smooth panel are really just SST capturing time-correlated variation, using the detrended SST, should collapse estimates back toward null.
d_detrend <- d |>
  group_by(stock_f) |>
  mutate(sst_detrend = resid(lm(sst_sc_lag1 ~ year_ct))) |>
  ungroup()

m_hgam_sst_detrend <- mgcv::gam(
  b0_sc ~ s(year_ct, k = 12, m = 2) +
    sst_detrend +
    s(stock_f, sst_detrend, bs = "re"),
  data = d_detrend,
  method = "REML"
)

get_slopes <- function(model, covariate, data) {
  ref_data <- tibble(
    stock_f = factor(levels(data$stock_f), levels = levels(data$stock_f)),
    year_ct = 0
  )
  ref_data[[covariate]] <- 0
  nd_pert <- ref_data
  nd_pert[[covariate]] <- 1
  Xd <- predict(model, newdata = nd_pert, type = "lpmatrix") -
    predict(model, newdata = ref_data, type = "lpmatrix")
  Vb <- vcov(model)
  ref_data |>
    mutate(
      estimate = as.numeric(Xd %*% coef(model)),
      se = sqrt(diag(Xd %*% Vb %*% t(Xd)))
    ) |>
    select(stock_f, estimate, se)
}

get_fixed <- function(model, covariate) {
  p <- summary(model)$p.table[covariate, ]
  tibble(estimate = unname(p["Estimate"]), se = unname(p["Std. Error"]))
}

sst_slopes <- bind_rows(
  get_slopes(m_hgam_sst, "sst_sc_lag1", d) |> mutate(version = "With per-stock year smooth"),
  get_slopes(m_hgam_sst_noyearslope, "sst_sc_lag1", d) |> mutate(version = "No per-stock year smooth, raw SST"),
  get_slopes(m_hgam_sst_detrend, "sst_detrend", d_detrend) |> mutate(version = "No per-stock year smooth, detrended SST")
) |>
  mutate(
    conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * se,
    sig = case_when(
      conf.low > 0 ~ "Positive sig.",
      conf.high < 0 ~ "Negative sig.",
      TRUE ~ "No effect"
    ),
    version = factor(version, levels = c(
      "With per-stock year smooth", "No per-stock year smooth, raw SST", "No per-stock year smooth, detrended SST"
    )),
    stock_f = reorder(stock_f, estimate)
  )

fixed_sst <- bind_rows(
  get_fixed(m_hgam_sst, "sst_sc_lag1") |> mutate(version = "With per-stock year smooth"),
  get_fixed(m_hgam_sst_noyearslope, "sst_sc_lag1") |> mutate(version = "No per-stock year smooth, raw SST"),
  get_fixed(m_hgam_sst_detrend, "sst_detrend") |> mutate(version = "No per-stock year smooth, detrended SST")
) |>
  mutate(
    conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * se,
    version = factor(version, levels = c(
      "With per-stock year smooth", "No per-stock year smooth, raw SST", "No per-stock year smooth, detrended SST"
    ))
  )

sst_slopes |> count(version, sig)

p1 <- ggplot(sst_slopes, aes(y = stock_f, x = estimate, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = sig)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = fixed_sst, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(data = fixed_sst, aes(xintercept = estimate), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Positive sig." = "tomato",
    "Negative sig." = "steelblue",
    "No effect"     = "grey70"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~version, ncol = 3) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(x = "SST total slope", y = NULL)

tag_facet(p1, open = "", close = "", fontface = 1, tag_pool = c("A", "B", "C"))

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/hgam_sst_concurvity_check.pdf"), width = 28, height = 23, units = "cm")
```

### SST vs trend-model residuals (no pooling)

```{r}
# 79 independent lm() fits, one per stock (residuals of hgam vs temperature, anything left to explain?)
d <- d |> mutate(resid_trend = residuals(m_hgam, type = "response"))

sst_reg_by_stock <- d |>
  group_by(stock_f) |>
  summarise(
    fit = list(lm(resid_trend ~ sst_sc_lag1)),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    estimate = map_dbl(fit, ~ coef(.x)["sst_sc_lag1"]),
    conf.low = map_dbl(fit, ~ confint(.x)["sst_sc_lag1", 1]),
    conf.high = map_dbl(fit, ~ confint(.x)["sst_sc_lag1", 2]),
    p_value = map_dbl(fit, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients["sst_sc_lag1", 4]),
    sig = case_when(
      conf.low > 0 ~ "Positive sig.",
      conf.high < 0 ~ "Negative sig.",
      TRUE ~ "No effect"
    )
  ) |>
  select(-fit)

sst_reg_by_stock |> count(sig)

ggplot(sst_reg_by_stock, aes(y = reorder(stock_f, estimate), x = estimate, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Positive sig." = "tomato",
    "Negative sig." = "steelblue",
    "No effect"     = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Per-stock regression slope\nSST vs trend-model residuals (no pooling)", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(0.05, 0.3, 0.05, 0.05, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/hgam_resid_sst_perreg.pdf"), width = 14, height = 23, units = "cm")
```
